Employees are entitled to 21 days of annual leave each year.
Unused leave may be carried over to the next year with manager approval.
Remote work is allowed two days per week.

Description 2026 is nothing short of a watershed moment for Al Agents. It has never been
more important to be an expert with Agentic Al. And that is precisely the goal of
this course: to equip you with the skills and expertise to design, build and deploy
Autonomous Al Agents, opening up new career and commercial opportunities.
This is an intensive 6-week program to master Agentic Al. We start by building
foundational expertise, connecting LLMs using proven design patterns. Then,
each week, we up

skill with new frameworks: OpenAl Agents SDK, CrewAl,
LangGraph and Autogen. The course culminates with a full week on the
remarkable opportunities opened up by MCP.

Above all, this is a hands-on course. I’m a big believer that the best way to learn is
by DOING. So please prepare to roll up your sleeves! We'll build 8 real-world
projects; some are astonishing, some are intriguing, and some are quite surreal.
But one thing’s for sure: all are powerful demonstrations of Agentic Al’s potential
to

utterly transform the business landscape.

So come join me on this comprehensive 6-week journey. By the end, you will
have mastered Agentic Al. You will have expertise in all the major frameworks.
You'll be well-versed in the strengths and traps of Agentic Al. You'll confidently
unleash Autonomous Agents to solve real-world commercial problems. And along
the way, you'll have had a whole lot of fun with the astounding, groundbreaking
technology that is Agentic Al.
